Alif-Laam-Meem .
kiya logon  ney yeh samajh rakha hai kay unhen yunhi chorr diya jaye ga kay bus woh yeh keh den kay :  hum emaan ley aaye  aur unn ko aazmaya naa jaye-?

halankay hum ney unn sabb ki aazmaesh ki hai jo unn say pehlay guzar chukay hain . lehaza Allah zaroor maloom ker kay rahey ga kay kon log hain jinhon ney sachai say kaam liya hai , aur woh yeh bhi maloom ker kay rahey ga kay kon log jhootay hain .
jinn logon  ney buray buray kaam kiye hain , kiya woh yeh samajhtay hain kay woh hum say bazi ley jayen gay-? boht bura andaza hai jo woh laga rahey hain .
jo shaks Allah say ja-milney ki umeed rakhta ho , ussay yaqeen rakhna chahiye kay Allah ki muqarrar ki hoi miyaad zaroor aa-ker rahey gi , aur wohi hai jo her baat sunta , her cheez janta hai .
aur jo shaks bhi humaray raastay mein mehnat uthata hai , woh apney hi faeeday kay liye mehnat uthata hai .   yaqeenan Allah tamam duniya jahan kay logon  say bey niaz hai .

aur jo log emaan ley aaye hain , aur unhon ney naik amal kiye hain , hum unn ki khataon ko zaroor unn say jhaarr den gay , aur jo amal woh kertay rahey hain , unn ka behtareen badla unhen zaroor den gay .

aur hum ney insan ko hukum diya hai kay woh apney walaiden kay sath acha sulook keray . aur agar woh tum per zor daalen kay tum meray sath kissi aesay ( mabood ) ko shareek thehrao jiss kay baaray mein tumharay paas koi daleel nahi hai to unn ka kehna matt maano .   meri hi taraf tum sabb ko loat ker aana hai , uss waqt mein tumhen bataon ga kay tum kiya kertay rahey ho .
aur jo log emaan laye hain , aur unhon ney naik amal kiye hain , hum unhen zaroor naik logon  mein shamil keren gay .

aur kuch log aesay hain kay woh keh detay hain kay :  hum Allah per emaan ley aaye hain  phir jab unn ko Allah kay raastay mein koi takleef phonchai jati hai to woh logon  ki phonchai hoi takleef ko aisa samajhtay hain jaisa Allah ka azab .   aur agar kabhi tumharay perwerdigar ki taraf say koi madad unn ( musalmanon ) kay paas aagae hai to woh zaroor yeh kahen gay kay :  hum to tumharay sath thay .    bhala kiya Allah ko woh baaten achi tarah maloom nahi hain jo saray duniya jahan kay logon  kay seenon mein chupi hain-?
aur Allah taalaa zaroor maloom ker kay rahey ga kay kon log emaan laye hain , aur woh zaroor maloom ker kay rahey ga kay kon log munafiq hain .

aur jinn logon  ney kufr apna liya hai , unhon ney emaan walon say kaha kay :  humaray raastay kay peechay chalo to hum tumhari khataon ka bojh uthalen gay  , halankay woh unn ki khataon ka zara bhi bojh nahi utha saktay , aur yeh log yaqeenan bilkul jhootay hain .

aur woh apney gunahon kay bojh bhi zaroor uthayen gay , aur apney bojh kay sath kuch aur bojh bhi .   aur yeh log jitney jhoot gharra kertay thay , qayamat kay din inn say unn sabb ki baaz purs zaroor ki jaye gi .
aur hum ney nooh ko unn ki qoam kay paas bheja tha , chunacheh pachas kam aik hazar saal tak woh unn kay darmiyan rahey , phir unn ko toofan ney aa-pakra , aur woh zalim log thay .
phir hum ney nooh ko aur kashti walon ko bacha liya , aur hum ney uss ko duniya jahan walon kay liye aik ibrat bana diya .
aur hum ney Ibrahim ko bheja jabkay unhon ney apni qoam say kaha tha kay :  Allah ki ibadat kero , aur uss say daro yehi baat tumharay liye behtar hai , agar tum samajh say kaam lo .

jo kuch tum kertay ho woh yeh hai kay Allah ko chorr ker tum button ko poojtay ho , aur jhooti baaten gharrtay ho . yaqeen jano kay Allah ko chorr ker jinn jinn ki tum ibadat kertay ho , woh tumhen rizq denay ka koi ikhtiyar nahi rakhtay , iss liye rizq Allah kay paas talash kero , aur uss ki ibadat kero , aur uss ka shukar ada kero . ussi kay paas tumhen wapis lotaya jaye ga .

aur agar tum mujhay jhutla rahey ho to tum say pehlay boht si qoamen jhutlaney ki rawish ikhtiyar ker-chuki hain , aur Rasool per iss kay siwa koi zimma daari nahi hoti kay woh saaf saaf baat phoncha dey .
bhala kiya inn logon  ney yeh nahi dekha kay Allah kiss tarah makhlooq ko shuroo mein peda kerta hai ? phir wohi ussay dobara peda keray ga , yeh kaam to Allah kay liye boht aasaan hai .

kaho kay :  zara zameen mein chal phir ker dekho kay Allah ney kiss tarah makhlooq ko shuroo mein peda kiya , phir Allah hi aakhirat wali makhlooq ko bhi utha kharra keray ga . yaqeenan Allah her cheez per qadir hai .
woh jiss ko chahye ga , saza dey ga , aur jiss per chahye ga reham keray ga , aur ussi ki taraf tum sabb ko palta kerlay jaya jaye ga .
aur tum naa zameen mein ( Allah ko ) aajiz ker-saktay ho , aur naa aasman mein , aur Allah kay siwa tumhara naa koi rakhwala hai , aur naa koi madadgaar .
aur jinn logon  ney Allah ki aayaton ka aur uss say ja-milney ka inkar kiya hai , woh meri rehmat say mayyus hochukay hain , aur unn kay liye dukh denay wala azab hai .

gharz Ibrahim ki qoam ka jawab iss kay siwa kuch nahi tha kay unhon ney kaha :  qatal ker daalo iss ko ya jala daalo issay !  phir Allah ney Ibrahim ko aag say bachaya . yaqeenan iss waqaey mein unn logon  kay liye bari ibraten hain jo emaan latay hain .

aur Ibrahim ney yeh bhi kaha kay :  tum ney Allah ko chorr ker button ko ( khuda ) maana huwa hai , jiss kay zariye dunyawi zindagi mein tumhari aapas ki dosti qaeem hai .   phir qayamat kay din tum aik doosray ka inkar kero gay , aur aik doosray per lanat bhejo gay , aur tumhara thikana dozakh hoga , aur tumhen kissi bhi tarah kay madadgaar moyassar nahi hon gay .
phir loot unn per emaan laye ,   aur Ibrahim ney kaha kay :  mein apney perwerdigar ki taraf hijrat ker kay jaraha hun ,   wohi hai jiss ka iqtidar bhi kamil hai , hikmat bhi kamil .

aur hum ney unhen Ishaq aur Yaqoob ( jaisay betay ) ata farmaye , aur unn ki aulad mein nabwooat aur kitab ka silsila jari rakha , aur unn ka ajar hum ney unhen duniya mein ( bhi ) diya aur yaqeenan aakhirat mein unn ka shumar sualeheen mein hoga .
aur hum ney loot ko bheja jabkay uss ney apni qoam say kaha :  haqeeqat yeh hai kay tum aesi bey hayai ka kaam kertay ho jo tum say pehlay duniya jahan walon mein say kissi ney nahi kiya .

kiya tum mardon kay paas jatay ho ,   aur raaston mein daakay daaltay ho , aur apni bhari majlis mein badi ka irtikab kertay ho-?  phir unn ki qoam kay logon  kay paas iss kay siwa koi jawab nahi tha kay unhon ney kaha :  ley aao hum per Allah ka azab agar tum sachay ho !
loot ney kaha :  meray perwerdigar ! inn mufsid logon  kay muqablay mein meri madad farmaiye .

aur jab humaray bhejay huye farishtay Ibrahim kay paas ( unn kay beta honey ki ) khushkhabri ley ker phonchay ,   to unhon ney kaha kay :  hum iss basti walon ko halak kernay walay hain . haqeeqat yeh hai kay iss kay bashinday baray zalim banay huye hain .

Ibrahim ney kaha :  iss basti mein to loot mojood hain .  farishton ney kaha :  hamen khoob maloom hai kay uss mein kon hai . hum unhen aur unn kay mutallaqeen ko zaroor bacha len gay , siwaye unn ki biwi kay kay woh unn logon  mein shamil rahey gi jo peechay reh jayen gay .

aur jab humaray bhejay huye farishtay loot kay paas phonchay to loot unn ki wajeh say sakht pareshan huye , aur unn ki wajeh say unn ka dil tang honey laga . unn farishton ney kaha :  aap naa dariye , aur naa ghum kijiye . hum aap ko aur aap kay mutallaqeen ko bachlen gay , siwaye aap ki biwi kay jo peechay reh janey walon mein shamil rahey gi .
iss basti kay bashinday jo bad-kaariyan kertay rahey hain , unn ki wajeh say hum unn per aasman say azab nazil kernay walay hain .
aur hum ney iss basti ki kuch khuli nishani unn logon  kay liye chorr di hai jo samajh say kaam len .

aur madiyan ki taraf hum ney unn kay bhai shoaib ko bheja . chunacheh unhon ney kaha :  meri qoam kay logo ! Allah ki ibadat kero , aur aakhirat walay din ki umeed rakho , aur zameen mein fasad phelatay matt phiro .
phir huwa yeh kay unn logon  ney shoaib ko jhutlaya , chunacheh zalzalay ney unn ko aa-pakra , aur woh apney ghar mein ondhay parray reh gaye .

aur hum ney aad aur samood ko bhi halak kiya , aur unn ki tabahi tum per unn kay gharon say wazeh hochuki hai .   aur shetan ney unn kay aemal ko unn ki nigahon mein khushnuma bana ker unhen raah-e-raast say rok diya tha , halankay woh soojh boojh kay log thay .

aur qaroon , firon aur hamaan ko bhi hum ney halak kiya .   musa unn kay paas roshan daleelen ley ker aaye thay , magar unhon ney zameen mein takabbur say kaam liya , aur woh ( hum say ) jeet naa sakay .

hum ney unn sabb ko unn kay gunahon ki wajeh say pakar mein liya , chunacheh unn mein say kuch woh thay jinn per hum ney pathrao kernay wali hawa bheji ,   aur kuch woh thay jinn ko aik chinghaarr ney aa-pakra ,   aur kuch woh thay jinn ko hum ney zameen mein dhansa diya ,   aur kuch woh jinhen hum ney paani mein gharq kerdiya .   aur Allah aisa nahi tha kay unn per zulm kerta , lekin yeh log khud apni janon per zulm kiya kertay thay .

jinn logon  ney Allah ko chorr ker doosray rakhwalay bana rakhay hain , unn ki misal makri ki si hai jiss ney koi ghar bana liya ho . aur khuli baat hai kay tamam gharon mein sabb say kamzor ghar makri ka hota hai . kaash kay yeh log jantay !
yeh log Allah ko chorr ker jiss jiss cheez ko pukartay hain Allah ussay khoob janta hai , aur woh iqtidar ka bhi malik hai , hikmat ka bhi malik .
hum yeh misalen logon  kay faeeday kay liye detay hain , aur unhen samajhtay wohi hain jo ilm walay hain .
Allah ney aasmano aur zameen ko bar-haq ( maqsad kay liye ) peda kiya hai .   dar-haqeeqat iss mein emaan walon kay liye bari nishani hai .

. ( aey payghumber ! ) jo kitab tumharay paas wahi kay zariye bheji gaee hai , uss ki tilawat kero , aur namaz qaeem kero . beyshak namaz bey hayai aur buray kamon say rokti hai ,   aur Allah ka ziker sabb say bari cheez hai . aur jo kuch tum kertay ho , Allah uss sabb ko janta hai .

aur ( musalmano ! ) ehal-e-kitab say behas naa kero , magar aesay tareeqay say jo behtareen ho , albatta unn mein say jo ziyadti keren , unn ki baat aur hai   aur ( unn say ) yeh kaho kay :  hum uss kitab per bhi emaan laye hain jo hum per nazil ki gaee hai , aur uss per bhi jo tum per nazil ki gaee thi , aur humara khuda aur tumhara khuda aik hai , aur hum ussi kay farmanbardaar hain .

aur ( aey payghumber ! ) issi tarah hum ney tum per kitab nazil ki hai , iss liye jinn logon  ko hum ney kitab di hai , woh iss per emaan latay hain , aur inn ( butt paraston ) mein say bhi kuch log hain jo iss per emaan laarahey hain , aur humari aayaton ka inkar sirf wohi log kertay hain jo kafir hain .
aur tum iss say pehlay naa koi kitab parhtay thay , aur naa koi kitab apney haath say likhtay thay . agar aisa hota to batil walay meen meekh nikal saktay thay .

haqeeqat to yeh hai kay yeh Quran aesi nishaniyon ka majmooa hai jo unn logon  kay seenon mein bilkul wazeh hain jinhen ilm ata kiya gaya hai , aur humari aayaton ka inkar sirf wohi log kertay hain jo zalim hain .

aur yeh log kehtay hain kay :  inn ( payghumber SallAllaho-alehi-wa-aalihi-wasallam ) per inn kay perwerdigar ki taraf say nishaniyan kiyon nahi utaari gaeen-?    ( aey payghumber ! inn say ) keh do kay :  nishaniyan sirf Allah kay paas hain , aur mein to aik wazeh tor per khabrdar kernay wala hun .

bhala kiya inn/unn kay liye yeh ( nishani ) kafi nahi hai kay hum ney tum per kitab utaari hai jo inn/unn ko parh ker sunai jarahi hai-? yaqeenan iss/uss mein inn/unn logon  kay liye bari rehmat aur naseehat hai jo manney walay hon .

keh do kay :  meray aur tumharay darmiyan gawahi denay kay liye Allah kafi hai , ussay unn tamam cheezon ka ilm hai jo aasmano aur zameen mein mojood hain . aur jo log batil per emaan laye hain , aur Allah ka inkar kiya hai , wohi hain jo sakht nuqsan uthaney walay hain .

aur yeh log tum say azab ki jaldi macha rahey hain . agar ( azab ka ) aik moyyan waqt naa hota to inn per zaroor azab aajata , aur woh aaye ga zaroor ( magar ) itna achanak kay inn ko pata bhi nahi chalay ga .
yeh tum say azab ki jaldi macha rahey hain , aur yaqeenan jahannum kafiron ko gheray mein ley ley gi ,
uss din jab azab unn per oopper say bhi chah jaye ga , aur inn kay paon kay neechay say bhi , aur kahey ga kay :  chakho unn kamon ka maza jo tum kiya kertay thay .
aey meray bando jo emaan laa-chukay ho ! yaqeen jano meri zameen boht wasee hai , lehaza khalis meri ibadat kero .
her mutanaffas ko moat ka zaiqa chakhna hai , phir humari hi taraf tum sabb ko wapis laya jaye ga .

aur jo log emaan laye hain , aur unhon ney naik amal kiye hain , unn ko hum zaroor jannat kay aesay bala-khano mein abad keren gay jinn kay neechay nehren behti hon gi , jahan woh hamesha hamesha rahen gay . behtareen ajar hai inn amal kernay walon ka ,
jinhon ney sabar say kaam liya , aur jo apney perwerdigar per bharosa kertay hain .
aur kitney janwer hain jo apna rizq uthaye nahi phirtay ! Allah unhen bhi rizq deta hai , aur tumhen bhi ,   aur wohi hai jo her baat sunta , her cheez janta hai .

aur agar tum unn say poocho kay :  kon hai jiss ney aasmano aur zameen ko peda kiya , aur sooraj aur chaand ko kaam per lagaya-?  to woh zaroor yeh kahen gay kay :  Allah !  phir aakhir yeh log kahan say ondhay chal parrtay hain-?
Allah apney bandon mein say jiss kay liye chahta hai , rizq mein kushadgi ker deta hai , aur jiss kay liye chahta hai , tangi ker deta hai , yaqeenan Allah her cheez ka mukammal ilm rakhta hai .

aur agar tum inn say poocho kay :  kon hai jiss ney aasman say paani barsaya , phir uss kay zariye zameen kay murda honey kay baad ussay zindagi baskshi-?  to woh zaroor yeh kahen gay kay :  Allah !  kaho :  Alhamdulillah !    lekin unn mein say aksar log aqal say kaam nahi letay .
aur yeh dunyawi zindagi khel kood kay siwa kuch bhi nahi ,   aur haqeeqat yeh hai kay daar-e-aakhirat hi asal zindagi hai , agar yeh log jantay hotay !

chunacheh jab yeh kashti mein sawar hotay hain to Allah ko iss tarah pukartay hain kay unn ka aetiqaad khalis ussi per hota hai .   phir jab woh unhen bacha ker khushki per ley aata hai to foran shirk kernay lagtay hain .
kerlen yeh log nashukri uss naimat ki jo hum ney unn ko di hai , aur uralen kuch mazay ! phir woh waqt door nahi jab enhen sabb pata chal jaye ga .

bhala kiya enhon ney yeh nahi dekha kay hum ney ( inn kay shehar ko ) aik pur-aman haram bana diya hai , jabkay inn kay ird-gird logon  ka haal yeh hai kay unhen uchak liya jata hai .   kiya phir bhi yeh batil per emaan latay hain , aur Allah ki naimat ki nashukri kertay hain-?

aur uss shaks say bara zalim kon hoga jo Allah per jhoota bohtan baandhay , ya jab uss kay paas haq ki baat phonchay to woh ussay jhutlaye-? kiya jahannum mein ( aesay ) kafiron ka thikana nahi hoga-?
aur jinn logon  ney humari khatir koshish ki hai , hum unhen zaroor bil-zaroor apney raaston per phonchayen gay ,   aur yaqeenan Allah naiki kernay walon kay sath hai .
